Bakcell is a telecommunications company in Azerbaijan.<ref>{{cite web |title=Bakcell company profile |url=https://www.reuters.com/markets/companies/BAKCELL.AZ |publisher=Reuters |access-date=}}</ref>

With nearly 9,000 base stations, it covers 99.9% of Azerbaijan's population and 92.6% of the country's territory. <ref>{{Cite web |title=Bakcell presented its new concept store in Barda-PHOTO-VIDEO |url=https://en.apa.az/infrastructure/bakcell-presented-its-new-concept-store-in-barda-photo-video-370750 |access-date=2025-01-15|website=Apa.az |language=en}}</ref> Bakcell provides telecommunications services to over 3 million subscribers.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-05-14|title=Bakcell offers the fastest fixed internet |url=https://en.trend.az/azerbaijan/society/3899326.html |access-date=2025-01-15|website=Trend.Az |language=en}}</ref>

The fastest mobile internet in Azerbaijan is provided by Bakcell. It was awarded the title of "Azerbaijan's Fastest Mobile Network" by Ookla from 2018 to 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Fastest Mobile Network Azerbaijan |url=https://www.speedtest.net/awards/bakcell/ |access-date=2025-01-15|website=www.speedtest.net}}</ref>

The company is part of [[NEQSOL Holding]], a diversified group of companies operating across various industries and countries. <ref>{{Cite web |title=New appointment to the Board of Directors of Bakcell |url=https://www.neqsolholding.com/ua/news-and-media/new-appointment-to-the-board-of-directors-of-bakcell/?l=UA |access-date=2025-01-15|website=www.neqsolholding.com |language=en}}</ref> The group's main areas of activity include oil and gas, telecommunications, high technologies, and construction. The operations and services of its companies extend to countries such as the United Kingdom, the United States, Turkey, Azerbaijan, Ukraine, Georgia, Kazakhstan, and the United Arab Emirates.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Brief Overview |url=https://www.neqsolholding.com/about-holding/brief-overview/?l=EN |access-date=2025-01-15|website=www.neqsolholding.com |language=en}}</ref>
